corrections.before: Any regular-symbol win starts two crossings.
corrections.after: Any non-Scatter win starts two crossings.

corrections.before: The board moves one reel left. A new rightmost reel enters. Existing reels remain intact; both directions are evaluated.
corrections.after: Move all reels one position left and draw the rightmost reel. Evaluate matching adjacent-row paths from the left.

corrections.before: All reels slide one position left and a new reel arrives on the right. Matching routes must stay within one row; multipliers 1x, 2x, 3x.
corrections.after: Move reels left and draw a new rightmost reel. From the left, each matching step stays level or moves one row up; multipliers 1x, 2x, 3x.

animation: New symbols enter opposite to the actual movement direction.
